## Episode Thesis

This episode is an investigative segment with Di/Privata Affärer journalist Frida Bratt about Energifonden. Energifonden is an unlisted investment company that markets high-yield bonds (5–9%) to Swedish retail savers through full-page ads. Bratt says the bonds are high-risk and illiquid, have no investor protection and no FI-registered prospectus because issues are kept just under the prospectus threshold and split across five subsidiaries, and a Norwegian subsidiary sold a vessel that soon began shipping Russian oil for the shadow fleet. The general market view is cautious: with high rates and market jitters, savers are steered toward diversified corporate bond funds and short or floating-rate (FRN) fixed-income funds rather than chasing yield.
